standard_prerequisites.name: Principalization of supported ideals on regular surfaces (schemes)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Resolution of Surfaces, lemma make-ideal-principal (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the blowup sequence on each etale neighbourhood making I_i invertible.

standard_prerequisites.name: Blowup sequences under the etale neighbourhood equivalence
standard_prerequisites.use: Assembles the per-neighbourhood sequences into one global sequence of blowups of X.

core_obligations: List T = {x_1, ..., x_r} and pick elementary etale neighbourhoods (U_i, u_i) -> (X, x_i) as in the strategy section; the restriction I_i is supported at u_i, where the local ring is regular of dimension 2.
Apply the scheme-case principalization lemma on each U_i to get a sequence of blowups in closed points over u_i with I_i invertible at the end.
Use the sequence-equivalence lemma to assemble one sequence X_m -> ... -> X_0 = X of blowups in closed points over T whose base changes to the U_i are the given sequences.
Check invertibility of I O_{X_n}: it holds over X minus T and on an etale neighbourhood of each fibre by construction, hence everywhere.
proof_roadmap: Etale localization at T; scheme-case principalization; global assembly through the equivalence; local-to-global invertibility check.
difficulty_reason: A localize-construct-assemble proof; the substantive step is patching the per-neighbourhood blowup sequences through the equivalence lemma and the two-region invertibility check.
